item.question: (a) A bus leaves at 10:40 a.m. and the trip takes 3 hours 30 minutes. When does it arrive? (b) A train leaves at 10:15 p.m. and the journey takes 5 hours 45 minutes. When does it arrive?
steps: (a) 10:40 a.m. is a morning time, so it is 10:40 hours.
10:40 hours plus 3 hours is 13:40 hours.
From 13:40 hours to 14:00 hours is 20 minutes, and 30 − 20 = 10 minutes are left, so 14:10 hours.
14 − 12 = 2, so 14:10 hours is 02:10 p.m. The clock passed 12 noon, so a.m. changed to p.m.
(b) 10:15 p.m. is 10 + 12 = 22, so it is 22:15 hours.
22:15 hours plus 5 hours is 27:15 hours. 27:15 hours plus 45 minutes is 28:00 hours, because 15 + 45 = 60 minutes make 1 more hour.
A day ends at 24:00 hours, so take 24 away: 28 − 24 = 4. The train arrives at 04:00 hours, which is 04:00 a.m. the next day.
Check: 10:15 p.m. to midnight is 1 hour 45 minutes, and midnight to 04:00 a.m. is 4 hours. 1 hour 45 minutes plus 4 hours is 5 hours 45 minutes.

item.question: It is 08:35 PM right now. What time will it be after 8 hours and 25 minutes?
steps_tex: 08:35 PM is a p.m. time, so add $12$ to the hour: $8 + 12 = 20$, and it is 20:35 hours.
Add the $25$ minutes first: 20:35 hours plus $25$ minutes is 21:00 hours.
Add the $8$ hours: 21:00 hours plus $8$ hours is 29:00 hours.
A day ends at 24:00 hours, so take $24$ away: $29 - 24 = 5$. The time is 05:00 hours the next day.
05:00 hours is a morning time, so it is 05:00 AM the next day.
Check: 08:35 PM to midnight is $3$ hours $25$ minutes, and midnight to 05:00 AM is $5$ hours. $3$ hours $25$ minutes plus $5$ hours is $8$ hours $25$ minutes.
